body: [{"streamId":"01a1d028-cf3f-7052-9d54-dd563bc6d0f6","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.DraftRefinementDispatched","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1d028-cf3f-7052-9d54-dd563bc6d0f6\u0022,\u0022SessionId\u0022:\u002201a1d029-7d31-76c8-9be1-42001591d06f\u0022,\u0022NodeId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4\u0022,\u0022DispatchedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-12T14:29:02.390318\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022Model\u0022:\u0022claude-opus-5-5[1m]\u0022,\u0022Effort\u0022:\u0022high\u0022,\u0022Purpose\u0022:\u0022Refine\u0022}","originEventId":"b619ed45-c327-4c53-8330-e32a70338d35","originSequence":183884,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-11-12T14:29:02.39098+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1d028-cf3f-7052-9d54-dd563bc6d0f6","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1d028-cf3f-7052-9d54-dd563bc6d0f6\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022On the node that dispatched a plan\\u0027s challenge, another node\\u0027s ceiling expiry for that challenge no longer parks the plan while this node is still running the session, so the plan takes the session\\u0027s own verdict when it lands.\u0022},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022A plan on this node has requested a challenge of a draft, and this node\\u0027s challenge engine has dispatched session S and is still running it. A DraftChallengeRecorded with failure DispatchExpired for S, recorded under this node\\u0027s id as another node writes it, then lands on the draft. A plan sweep that runs while S is still running does not park the plan, and the plan still records the challenge as requested. When S\\u0027s verdict is recorded afterwards, the next plan sweep moves the draft exactly as the same verdict would without the expiry (for example, publish as written leaves the draft ready). An integration test covers this and fails without the change, because the first sweep parks the plan with ChallengeFailed.\u0022,\u0022When the same expiry lands and this node is not running S (it never dispatched S, or S\\u0027s session is no longer running on this node, as after a restart), the next plan sweep parks the plan with ChallengeFailed, as it does at a8cfd74dd. An integration test covers the case where this node dispatched S but no longer runs it, so a session that died cannot hold a plan waiting forever.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022## Where this came from\\n\\nA review of another task\\u0027s diff (01a1cfe6, which makes the dispatching node\\u0027s own challenge or refinement outcome\\nwin over another node\\u0027s foreign-session ceiling expiry on the task stream, and adds a settle period before a sweep\\nrecords such an expiry) reported that the plan stream still parks on the expiry. This task is the part of that report\\nthat holds at a8cfd74dd. Part of the report does not hold, and is recorded below so the build does not chase it.\\n\\n## The defect, at a8cfd74dd\\n\\nA plan is a fact about one node: every plan event is node-scoped and never replicates\\n(\\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Infrastructure/Persistence/EventScopeRegistry.cs\\u0060, the Hall9k.Domain.Features.Plan block). So the\\nonly plan that can go wrong is the one on node A, which requested the challenge and whose challenge engine runs\\nsession S.\\n\\n- Another node B records \\u0060DraftChallengeRecorded\\u0060 with \\u0060ChallengeFailureReason.DispatchExpired\\u0060 for S once S\\u0027s dispatch\\n  has stood past \\u0060ForeignPublicationCeiling\\u0060 (one hour by default) by B\\u0027s clock\\n  (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/Challenge/DraftChallengeEngine.cs\\u0060, the foreign branch of \\u0060RecoverAsync\\u0060). It records it under\\n  the dispatching node\\u0027s id, so on A the expiry carries A\\u0027s own node id and is told apart only by its failure.\\n- A live A ends its own session within \\u0060ChallengeTimeout\\u0060 (30 minutes), so B\\u0027s expiry reaches A before S\\u0027s verdict\\n  only when A\\u0027s clock stood still or ran slow relative to B\\u0027s: A suspended while S ran, then woke and pulled B\\u0027s\\n  expiry before S finished. When it does, the expiry applies to the task (S is the running session), which clears\\n  \\u0060RunningChallengeSessionId\\u0060.\\n- The absorption loop in \\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/Plan/PlanEngine.cs\\u0060 \\u0060StepAsync\\u0060 (lines 280 to 296) takes any latest\\n  challenge outcome recorded at or after the plan\\u0027s request once no challenge is running. It takes the expiry, and\\n  \\u0060PlanDecider.AfterChallenge\\u0060 parks a non-verdict as \\u0060ChallengeFailed\\u0060\\n  (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Plan/Handlers/PlanDecider.cs\\u0060). \\u0060PlanDraftState.Apply(PlanParked)\\u0060 clears\\n  \\u0060ChallengeRequestedAt\\u0060, so when S\\u0027s verdict lands moments later the loop never looks at it again. The plan stays\\n  parked until a person resumes it, and the task shows a verdict the plan ignored.\\n\\nThis reproduces on main alone: at a8cfd74dd the challenge appliers have no guard, so S\\u0027s verdict also lands as the\\nlatest outcome after the expiry. It does not depend on 01a1cfe6\\u0027s change. It is blocked by that task, not stacked on\\nit, because both edit \\u0060PlanEngine.cs\\u0060 and \\u0060PlanEngineTests\\u0060, and 01a1cfe6 changes when a foreign expiry is recorded\\nand how those tests run sweeps, so building on main after it merges avoids writing tests against behavior about to\\nmove.\\n\\n## What the report claimed that does not hold\\n\\n- \\u0022The plan ends up parked on every node\\u0022 and \\u0022the replicated park clears the plan\\u0027s RunningSessionId\\u0022: plan events do\\n  not replicate, so B holds no plan for the draft and parks nothing.\\n- The refinement path: on B, \\u0060RecordEndAsync\\u0060 finds no plan through \\u0060PlanOfAsync\\u0060, so the expiry is task-only. On A,\\n  the plan\\u0027s draft keeps \\u0060RunningSessionId\\u0060 = R, \\u0060PlanDecider.NextStep\\u0060 returns \\u0060AwaitSession\\u0060 without reading the\\n  task, and A\\u0027s own \\u0060RecordEndAsync\\u0060 for R still matches the plan and moves it through \\u0060AfterRefinement\\u0060. Nothing on\\n  the refinement side needs to change.\\n\\n## The smallest change\\n\\nOnly the absorption loop needs a rule: a \\u0060DispatchExpired\\u0060 outcome recorded under this node\\u0027s id, for a session this\\nnode\\u0027s challenge engine is still running, is not absorbed; the loop waits for that session\\u0027s own outcome. Every other\\noutcome is absorbed as today. How the plan engine learns that the challenge engine still runs S is the build\\u0027s choice.\\nBoth engines are singletons (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/Program.cs\\u0060), and the challenge engine keeps its live sessions in\\n\\u0060_running\\u0060, a \\u0060HashSet\\u003CGuid\\u003E\\u0060 read and written only on its own sweep today, so any read from the plan engine\\u0027s sweep\\nneeds to be thread-safe. The challenge engine records a session\\u0027s outcome before removing it from \\u0060_running\\u0060 (the\\n\\u0060finally\\u0060 in \\u0060DispatchAsync\\u0060), which is what lets the plan see the verdict before it sees the session gone.\\n\\n## Notes\\n\\n- No docs change is expected: docs/cli.md already describes the foreign-session ceiling, and 01a1cfe6 adds that the\\n  dispatching node\\u0027s outcome wins over an expiry, which this task makes true for the plan as well.\\n- Tests go in \\u0060tests/Hall9k.Tests/Integration/PlanEngineTests.cs\\u0060. Those tests record challenge outcomes by appending\\n  \\u0060DraftChallengeRecorded\\u0060 directly and run no challenge engine, so whatever seam tells the plan engine that S is still\\n  running on this node must be one a test can set without spawning a session.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u002201a1cfe6-1188-74e9-a49e-88dfe8516528\u0022]},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-12T14:33:26.289427\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022HumanGate\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RefinementSessionId\u0022:\u002201a1d029-7d31-76c8-9be1-42001591d06f\u0022,\u0022FeedbackStep\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"5ebfbdfc-13da-4307-acc3-19cf660cf34c","originSequence":183886,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-11-12T14:33:26.314944+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1d028-cf3f-7052-9d54-dd563bc6d0f6","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.PublicationTokensRecorded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1d028-cf3f-7052-9d54-dd563bc6d0f6\u0022,\u0022InputTokens\u0022:46,\u0022OutputTokens\u0022:19726,\u0022CostUsd\u0022:1.2337222,\u0022RecordedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-12T14:33:31.129758\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022CacheReadInputTokens\u0022:1378011,\
